maintenance_led.reason: Sells newly developed residential lots to homebuilders (mainly D.R. Horton); new development, not repair or replacement.

publicly_funded.reason: Lot sales paid by private homebuilders, chiefly D.R. Horton, funded by private homebuyers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows by developing and selling lots organically; land purchases are inventory, and D.R. Horton's majority stake isn't a roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Finished residential lots are sold to homebuilders; they can buy lots from other developers, and no integration or re-qualification is needed.
